For [expression](/docs/shell/commands/categories/expression/).

<div class='command-title'>Creates a selector that selects all columns.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars selector all` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars selector all {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input | output          |
| ----- | --------------- |
| any   | polars_selector |
## Examples

Create a selector for all columns
```nu
> polars selector all

```

Multiply all columns by 2 using with-column
```nu
> [[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]]
                    | polars into-df
                    | polars with-column ((polars selector all) * 2)
                    | polars collect
╭───┬───┬───╮
│ # │ a │ b │
├───┼───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 2 │ 4 │
│ 1 │ 6 │ 8 │
╰───┴───┴───╯

```
